description:
Two contract gaps are reported in `crates/gf2-core/src/field/charpoly.rs`: `keller_gehrig_charpoly` documents a panic on non-square input but only `debug_assert`s (line 1477), and the Wiedemann arm of `minpoly` for $n > 32$ accepts a candidate on probabilistic probes only (line 1110).

## Background

Reported by the field-matrix comment sweep.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test reproduces the reported behavior at the cited location, or a record shows the report does not hold and the issue is rejected with that evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: `keller_gehrig_charpoly` panics on non-square input in every profile, or its Rustdoc states the debug-only check as an `_unchecked`-style precondition per `@/inv/caller-trusted-fast-paths`.
- [hard] REQ-03: `minpoly` returns an exact result for every $n$, or its Rustdoc states the failure probability of the probabilistic arm.
title: Field charpoly and minpoly contract gaps reported by the comment sweep
